trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled checkout-api back to it in all regions. Verified post-rollback health: **healthy, error rate down to 0.2%**.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) describing the failure and the rollback action — the on-call engineer has been paged. The first incident-creation attempt timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key to prevent duplicates.

Follow-up recommended: diagnose the v2.3.1 regression before attempting to redeploy it.
